locations.name: The Broken Overpass
locations.text: The overpass has half-collapsed into the road below. Cars sit rusted where they stalled the day everything stopped.

locations.name: Rusted Checkpoint
locations.text: An old checkpoint gate, jammed. Slip through (DEX) or talk the ancient automated system into opening (INT).

locations.name: Flooded Atrium
locations.text: Waist-deep standing water, current stronger than it should be. Cross it, or find what's making it move.

locations.name: Vending Row
locations.text: ENCOUNTER: Scrap-Rat Swarm. Defeat, stun, or escape it.

locations.name: Collapsed Escalator
locations.text: MILESTONE: The escalator hides a maintenance stairwell down. Reward: +1 to hero HP threshold (permanent), draw 1 Spell/Ability card into hand.

locations.name: The Humming Vault
locations.text: A warded door, still very much alive. Bypass the wards without waking whatever's sleeping behind them.

locations.name: The Static Warden
locations.text: ENCOUNTER / FINAL: The Static Warden. Defeat or stun it to claim the signal core.
